reason: Three months free costs me nothing, so I'd put the QR codes on a few tables and see if guests use them and if the regulars list brings anyone back. If it hasn't brought in more than 59 lari of repeat business by month four, I cancel.
objection: My guests are used to handing over a card or cash. I doubt many will scan a code and pay on their phone, and the payment partner's fee goes on top of what my bank terminal already charges me.
would_change_my_mind: If after the free months fewer than about a fifth of tables pay by QR, or the transaction fee is higher than my terminal's, I won't pay the 59 lari.
